category_title: Students who experience academic belittlement or low expectations from instructors based on their identity
minimal_context: The student asks the instructor to slow down during a lecture and confronts him about a microaggression he previously made in front of the class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's move on to the next topic. We have a lot of material to get through today.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I didn't understand one of the concepts you were talking about. Could you please slow down?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I can try, but we really need to stay on schedule.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: It's just hard to ask for help. Last time I asked you to slow down, you made fun of me.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I'm not sure what you're referring to.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: You said, 'Hey everyone, I guess I have to slow down for the Chinese girl.' No one thought it was funny, and it challenged my identity right in front of the class.
